service: US FDIC BankFind Institution & Solvency Risk Auditor
description: Audits U.S. FDIC-insured commercial banks and savings institutions via the official FDIC BankFind Suite API. Extracts total assets, deposits, equity capital, ROA, ROE, and calculates counterparty solvency health scores (0-100) for corporate treasury teams.

inputSchema.title: US FDIC BankFind Institution & Solvency Risk Auditor Input
inputSchema.description: Configure bank name, US state filter, active status, and maximum results to audit FDIC-insured financial institutions and counterparty treasury risk.

institutionName.title: Bank / Institution Name (Optional)
institutionName.description: Optional bank name keyword (e.g., 'JPMorgan', 'Citibank', 'Morgan Stanley', 'Bank of America').

state.title: US State Code (Optional)
state.description: 2-letter US State code of bank headquarters (e.g., 'NY', 'CA', 'TX', 'OH', 'NC', 'SD').

activeOnly.title: Active FDIC Institutions Only
activeOnly.description: Filter exclusively for currently active FDIC-insured banks (ACTIVE=1).

maxResults.title: Maximum Institutions to Audit
maxResults.description: Maximum number of FDIC institutions to extract and score (1 to 200).

institutionName.title: Institution Name
institutionName.description: Official legal name of the banking institution.

activeStatus.title: Active Status
activeStatus.description: True if currently active and insured by the FDIC.

totalAssetsMillionsUsd.title: Total Assets ($ Millions)
totalAssetsMillionsUsd.description: Total consolidated assets reported in millions of USD.

totalDepositsMillionsUsd.title: Total Deposits ($ Millions)
totalDepositsMillionsUsd.description: Total domestic and foreign deposits in millions of USD.

equityRatioPct.title: Equity-to-Assets Ratio (%)
equityRatioPct.description: Tier/Book Equity capital as a percentage of total assets.

roaPct.title: Return on Assets — ROA (%)
roaPct.description: Net income as a percentage of average total assets.

counterpartyHealthScore.title: Counterparty Health Score (0-100)
counterpartyHealthScore.description: Quantitative treasury solvency & capital adequacy score (0-100).

markdownTreasuryRiskBrief.title: Markdown Treasury Counterparty Risk Brief
markdownTreasuryRiskBrief.description: Executive Markdown dossier for CFOs, Corporate Treasurers, and Fintech Risk Teams.

overview.title: US FDIC BankFind Institution & Solvency Risk Overview
